name: wf-core-authoring
description: wf core-authoring pack: the core-authoring capability, carrying the knowledge for authoring the wf core plugin itself — the domain-free skill spine, the frozen contracts under the core plugin's _contracts folder, and the repository authoring rules its CI gates enforce. Declared kind: both; it ships its own skills and is authored to attach phase fragments. Its first contribution is the distilled authoring-vocabulary article it declares as constitution articles, so a session in this repository starts with those rules in its injected context; it also carries the craft-C4 authoring lint its own fixtures runner gates in CI, and its Fragments table stays deliberately empty until the first phase fragment lands. Ships /wf-core-authoring:init for one-command self-registration of the capability, and /wf-core-authoring:new-contract to scaffold a core contract pair that is green under the repository's contract-shape guard on its first run.
